label: Rift backup file format
type: one of cbbackupmgr's two backup-archive file formats, alongside backup:sqlite-backup-format. Deliberately in the backup: namespace, not storage-engine:*, which names the Server data engines (Plasma/Forestdb/Nitro/couchstore/magma) rather than a backup file's own on-disk encoding. Inspected via tool:cbriftdump. Does NOT support key-deduplication during merge, unlike the SQLite format.
evidence: Note that this deduplication does not currently happen with the Rift format.
relates_to_competency_question: What are the two possible on-disk encodings of a cbbackupmgr backup file, and do they behave the same way under merge?
